items.t: Risk Factors for Normal-tension Glaucoma Progression: A Review
items.sum: This review identified disc hemorrhages, intraocular pressure variability, and systemic vascular dysregulation as consistent predictors of normal-tension glaucoma progression, highlighting the need for risk stratification to guide individualized treatment, follow-up, and prognosis.  Normal-tension glaucoma (NTG) is characterized by progressive optic neuropathy despite intraocular pressure (IOP) consistently within the conventionally defined normal limits.

items.t: Early Outcomes of the Paul Glaucoma Implant in Children With Refractory Glaucoma

To evaluate early intraocular pressure control, medication use, and short-term safety after Paul glaucoma implant surgery in children with refractory glaucoma.
